Each test is log10 of a ratio of two gains, with a 95% percentile interval over 2000 resamples of every cell's trajectories, seeded from the registration id; inconclusive whenever a gain is undefined. Supported if the interval of G(32)/G(8) at σ = 0.5 lies above log10 5; contradicted if it lies wholly below log10 5; else inconclusive.
body.statement: Size buys robustness to noise: at σ = 0.5 the lock gain of the N = 32 crystal is at least five times that of the N = 8 crystal.
